No healinindia.gov.in, NMC/TSMC, university, ORCID or Scholar profile surfaced - expected for a consultant who only completed his DM in 2024.

NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED - AND ONE NUMBER WAS DELIBERATELY DISCARDED. A search-result summary asserted a contact number of '+91 40 4244 4222' for him. That is AIG Hospitals' central switchboard / booking line, not a line dedicated to this doctor; recording a hospital central number as a doctor's own is expressly barred, and it surfaced only via an aggregator listing summary rather than an AIG per-doctor publication. It was therefore DISCARDED and no exact-phrase confirmation was pursued. The pipeline's automatic hospital-level fallback from state/hospital_contacts.json covers the switchboard route anyway. Nothing was constructed from the aighospitals.com domain.

GENDER NOTE FOR HUMAN REVIEW: 'Meena' is commonly a female given name in India, but the AIG and directory biographies for this doctor use male pronouns. Any outreach should avoid assuming a salutation - the AIG page is the authority.
